def solve(case):
    matrix = case['matrix']
    idf = case['idf']
    vector = case['vector']
    num_terms = len(matrix[0]) if matrix else 0
    degree = []
    result = []
    for j in range(num_terms):
        col_sum = 0
        weighted_sum = 0.0
        for i, row in enumerate(matrix):
            if row[j] == 1:
                col_sum += 1
                weighted_sum += vector[i]
        degree.append(col_sum)
        result.append(idf[j] * weighted_sum)
    return {"degree": degree, "result": result}
